method: FM3-Edit CPU readout, Scene 1, blocks replaced one by one with a shunt (subtractive); user-read, 0.1 % resolution. Bypassed blocks cost the same CPU (Fractal wiki), so presence counts, not engagement.
consistency: B6 (compressor, drive, amp, cab, delay, reverb remain) = 52.9 vs A5 with the same blocks = 52.8.

baseline.scope: In 1, Out 1, Send, Return and shunts of the two-row layout

amp.note: Amp runs on its own core; this meter barely moves

delay.note: Delay shares the amp core (Fractal wiki); this meter barely moves

synth.note: B0 exceeded the limit; cost not measurable from this session

crossCheck.note: Same families as session A minus compressor, but other types (Plate: Medium Plate, Digital Stereo, DS1 Distortion Mod, amp channel D): type-dependent cost differs by about +16 %. Family-level costs are therefore exact only for the measured types.

limit.source: Fractal wiki: up to 80 % is safe; beyond that audio mutes with a warning
